title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text: UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India. The detailed Advertisement No. 14/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been scheduled to be uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Application Portal https://upsconline.nic.in from 28th November, 2026 to 18th December, 2026 . Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein. ******* SG/AK
